meta.name: hyperframes-keyframes
meta.description: Use when a HyperFrames composition needs a punch-in, punch-out, zoom, reframe, Ken Burns treatment, camera move, visual match/whip handoff, or other seek-safe 2D/3D keyframes; also for GSAP, CSS keyframes, Anime.js, WAAPI, FLIP, paths, masks, SVG morph/draw, text trails, 3D depth, or `hyperframes keyframes` diagnostics. Don't use for broad scene strategy, brand design, media sourcing, captions, or general video planning.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 给视频添加推拉缩放、运镜和转场关键帧动画
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你想给视频片段添加电影感的推拉缩放和运镜动画
copy.tagline_en: Add punch-in, zoom, reframe, and camera-move keyframes to video compositions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you edit video and want cinematic push-in, zoom, and camera-move animation

howto.what: Claude 会为 HyperFrames 视频画面的动作创建关键帧，用于实现缩放、平移、裁剪等视觉效果，并保证这些关键帧在时间轴上可安全跳转、输出经过像素级验证。随后还会运行诊断命令检查。
howto.when: 当用户需要对 HyperFrames 画面做推拉、缩放等镜头动作，或要求用 GSAP 等工具生成关键帧时触发。

say.text: 给这段 HyperFrames 视频加一个缓慢的推近效果。
say.note: Claude 会添加一组缩放关键帧并做验证。

say.text: 用 GSAP 让主体在 2 秒内从左移动到右。
say.note: Claude 会生成可安全定位的 GSAP 关键帧动画。

say.text: 运行 hyperframes keyframes 帮我检查当前场景。
say.note: Claude 会执行诊断工具并解读结果。

howto.what_en: Claude will create keyframes for camera actions in HyperFrames compositions, enabling effects such as zoom, pan, and crop. These keyframes are seek-safe in the timeline and pixel-verified. It will then run diagnostic checks to validate the result.
howto.when_en: Triggers when a user wants punch-in/out, zoom, or GSAP-driven keyframes for HyperFrames compositions.

say_en.text: Add a slow push-in to this HyperFrames video.
say_en.note: Claude adds and verifies a set of zoom keyframes.

say_en.text: Use GSAP to move the subject from left to right in two seconds.
say_en.note: Claude creates a seek-safe GSAP keyframe animation.

say_en.text: Run hyperframes keyframes to check my current scene.
say_en.note: Claude runs the diagnostic and explains the output.
